nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: $USR, I'm `SO` alone. So very alone. The darkness is closing in... Closing in...
nodes.text_bbcode: $USR, I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]SO[/i][/color] alone. So very alone. The darkness is closing in... Closing in...

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Oh, wait. You're probably on your date right now, huh?

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Oh man... I'm `so` pathetic... Interrupting a guy on a date on Valentine's Day to complain about being alone...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh man... I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] pathetic... Interrupting a guy on a date on Valentine's Day to complain about being alone...

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: This is truly rock bottom. Please do me a favor and forget I called.
Dontae hangs up the phone!
But wait! You got a perfect score! Ready to see your bonus scene?
For this, let's check in on how Dontae's date with Paige is going!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, thanks for dinner. Here's where I live.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Cool. Do you want to show me around?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Boys aren't allowed in! Don't be silly.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Oh. Some kind of all girls' school? Well. We could go grab dessert somewhere.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's getting late... I should get back. All in all, I've had worse Valentine's Days. But now I've got to go.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Huh? What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Um, sorry, buddy, but I have curfew!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: What kind of college has curfew?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: College? I'm not in college. Monarch Prep is a `high school!`
nodes.text_bbcode: College? I'm not in college. Monarch Prep is a [color=#3b78e2][i]high school![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hee hee. Sorry, but I can't get caught breaking curfew `again` this week. So see you later!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hee hee. Sorry, but I can't get caught breaking curfew [color=#3b78e2][i]again[/i][/color] this week. So see you later!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Later...
Looks like things could have gone better for Dontae... But Paige was too young for him anyway!
We hope you enjoyed this special Valentine's Day edition of Surviving High School! See you next time!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You're right... It's just pathetic. Come on, girls. Let's get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah... We can do better. `Much` better.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... We can do better. [color=#3b78e2][i]Much[/i][/color] better.

nodes.text: The girls link arms and leave.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: That was a disaster! How could you let that happen?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Okay, so that didn't work... But you've got to get back on the horse... Try again... Get back on the bike.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Only... You might be riding solo this time. I've got to get to my date.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: It's hopeless. I'm going to die alone.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Sorry, man. But I've got to go.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: It's all right. You did your best. I'm just undateable.
You pat Dontae on the shoulder and head out to your Valentine's Day date...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Wrong! It was a tiger shark! I knew it! This is all just a lie,

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Prissy's right! It `was` a tiger shark in the story! Are you guys lying to us?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Prissy's right! It [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] a tiger shark in the story! Are you guys lying to us?!

nodes.prompt: Are you guys lying to us?!

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Are you guys lying to us?!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: How could you accuse us of telling an untruth? That's hurtful.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Girls, girls, have a little faith in humanity.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, come on. It's pretty obvious what you're doing.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: But you can't blame a guy for telling a little fib to impress a girl, right?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, actually, we `can!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, yeah, actually, we [color=#3b78e2][i]can![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Aw, I think it's kind of funny. Besides, who would fall for such a ridiculous lie?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: That's right! I guess you just might be telling the truth.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: How could you be doubting us?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, you've got to admit, it's a pretty crazy story. I wouldn't put it past a couple fast-talking college guys like you to tell a few lies to impress us.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Paige has a point... But you wouldn't lie to us... Would you?

nodes.prompt: You wouldn't lie to us... Would you?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: You wouldn't lie to us... Would you?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Hey, Dontae, you should tell these girls about that time you saved that baby.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Huh? What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: You know... That story that's so amazing, it's unbelievable...

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I mean it's hard to believe it's true. `But it is.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean it's hard to believe it's true. [color=#e23b3b][i]But it is.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Oh! Right! Yeah, I should! Well, last week we were having a frat party on the beach.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: And this family was there with these little kids playing in the water and swimming...

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Suddenly the mom starts screaming! 'Shark! Shark!' We look out, and her little kid's paddling next to a tiger shark!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: What did you do?!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: I did what I had to do. I kept my cool and dove into the ocean and grabbed that kid from the jaws of the beast. I felt its teeth graze my arm as I pulled the kid away...

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: OMG! You're a total hero!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Well, a lot of people were throwing that word around that day. But me, I say I was just in the right place at the right time.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: That's a pretty crazy story. I can't believe all that happened.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: It's true. Every word of it.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: So you were there, $USR? What kind of shark was it again?

nodes.prompt: What kind of shark was it again?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What kind of shark was it again?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wow! A frat guy, huh? I `love` frat guys!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow! A frat guy, huh? I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] frat guys!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Yeah, frats are `so` cool.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, frats are [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] cool.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Well, I'm a real, live frat guy! Any questions?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Did you really have to do all kinds of weird stuff when you were a pledge?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Do you throw huge parties on campus and get into tons of trouble?

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Do you sign up for classes and then `not go to those classes?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you sign up for classes and then [color=#3b78e2][i]not go to those classes?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Yes to all of those things.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: So cool!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: He's like a total genius.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Uh, that's right! I'm brilliant.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: All right, let's hear a palindrome.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Uh... 'Racecar'. That's a palindrome.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, but that didn't make any sense.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Ummm... Go jog!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you telling me to go jogging?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Abort! Abort!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Er, you know, genius can't be rushed.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Okay, that's everything! Let's go to that mixer.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Thanks, man. You really saved my life.
You and Dontae head to the Carnival of Love's Mixer of Love...

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Awesome! There are a ton of hot girls here.
People mingle around the room, with a group of hot girls standing at the center.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hee hee! I love college parties.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: I can't believe you talked us into sneaking out of Monarch Prep...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Don't be such a wet blanket! This is totally amazing.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I don't think those girls go here...

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Who cares? They're hot! Come on, you've got to introduce me!
Dontae drags you over to where the girls are and nudges you.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Ahem, ahem. Excuse me, have you met my friend Dontae? He's...

nodes.prompt: Have you met my friend Dontae? He's...

options.label: The most popular guy in the MAN frat.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Have you met my friend Dontae? He's...

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: All right, now can we go? All the good single girls are going to be taken by the time we get there!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: There's one last thing. I need to stop by the store on the way to the mixer to pick up some candy.
A short drive later...

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Whoa! This store's been wiped out!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I guess waiting until Valentine's Day might not have been the best idea...

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Looks like you can pick between this heart-shaped box of candy hearts or this chocolate rose.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Well, the candy hearts have cute little messages on them... But the chocolate rose is kind of pretty... I'll take...

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Wow... It really does smell like ninjas.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Wow, that stuff is strong!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Okay, ready to go?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Hang on a second. I should wear some cologne, right? Let's see...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I've got some 'Haxe' body spray.
Dontae picks up the bottle.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: 'Made from the sweat of rockstars and ninjas!'

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Or I have this cologne my grandma gave me... 'Midnight Musk'.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I'll spray on...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yeah, I think I look fine.
After a quick change...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: There, that's better.
Just then, Dontae comes into your room.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Hey, $USR. Bryce, ready to go? The Carnival of Love's Mixer of Love isn't going to wait all night.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Er... About that... I... Kind of have a date.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: WHAT?! You're supposed to be my wingman! I can't fly in there solo! You know I can't talk to girls on my own!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Sorry, something came up. There's this hot cheerleader that I'm going to take to the Queen of Hearts Dance at Centerscore High.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: A `high school` dance? LAME!
nodes.text_bbcode: A [color=#e23b3b][i]high school[/i][/color] dance? LAME!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Sorry, man. I can't stand a girl up. But... I know someone who's got a couple hours to kill...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: $USR can take my place!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Wait a second, I...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Thanks buddy, see you later!
Bryce dives out the door and runs!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Sorry to drag you into this, $USR, but you've got to help me.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Fine, fine. Just let me finish getting ready for my date first. I was thinking about changing into something nicer... I've got a tux I could wear.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: You might just want to go casual. I guess it depends on the girl, and on what you're doing.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Right... I think I'll wear...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Her sorority's throwing the big Valentine's Day Carnival on campus, so we're going to go check that out together.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Sounds fun.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yeah, it should be great! And before that, I'm going to surprise her by putting a teddy bear and flowers in her room.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I'm supposed to head over to the OMG house in just a couple hours.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Do goth girls even celebrate Valentine's Day?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I might have to talk her into it. We're going to check out that Valentine's Day Carnival on campus. I heard they have a haunted house of love there.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: And then we'll go to a museum with a Valentine's Day exhibit.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Sounds... Interesting.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Well, I've got my fingers crossed. I'm supposed to meet her in just a couple hours...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Oh, right, the movie star! That's awesome! She's the one in 'A Kiss to Remember', right?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yeah, that's her movie! Tonight, I'll be walking the red carpet with her. My flight leaves in just a couple hours...
You rush around the room, scattering rose petals, placing a vase of flowers on her desk, and even setting up a cute stuffed bear...
When you're done, it looks perfect!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Great! I did it.
Just then, the door opens.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: $USR? What did you... This is amazing!
Beth throws her arms around you!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: You're the best! I can't believe you did this for me. What a cute bear. I'm going to name him '$USR-Bear'.
You throw the ball as hard as you can and hit the bottles!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Winner, winner! Here you go, young man, a prize for your pretty lady.
James hands you a huge stuffed swan!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: My lady.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Awww! You're the best!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Now $USR-bear will have a friend.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Sorry... But this is for OMG. I don't want to make Tina mad at me.
So, later that night...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: And now, we've got the winner of the 'Jobless Loser' Award. This goes to the boyfriend who was too broke to even afford tickets to the carnival!
Tina calls up one of the boyfriends and the sorority sisters shout out insults.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: This is just depressing.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I'm not sure I believe in relationships anymore...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: The worst part is, it doesn't even matter what guys do `right.` Tina and the other girls find `some` way to tear us down.
nodes.text_bbcode: The worst part is, it doesn't even matter what guys do [color=#e23b3b][i]right.[/i][/color] Tina and the other girls find [color=#e23b3b][i]some[/i][/color] way to tear us down.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: And next up, we've got $USR! Come on up, $USR.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Gulp.
You climb up the stairs to the stage and stand next to Tina.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Okay, girls. Let's see how $USR stacked up.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: His award is... 'Weakling'! He couldn't even win Beth a prize at the carnival!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: His biggest mistake of the night was this truly horrible cologne that he's wearing. Yuck!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: So his award is... 'Cat Funeral'!
You throw the ball... But it falls short!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Oooh no! Looks like you didn't measure up.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: But I'll tell you what... Since I know you're a good guy, here's a consolation prize.
James hands you a small, ugly stuffed spider.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Er... Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Yuck! That's disgusting!
Suddenly, Tina pops up.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Hmm... Gave date a grotesque stuffed insect. Not good.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Sorry, can't stay to chat. I've got other boyfriends to judge and relationships to ruin, you know how it is.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Step right up, step right up! Try your luck and win a prize for your girl!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Wow, James, they got you running this game?

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Hey, the MAN frat is always up for helping the OMG sisters. Now, you think you're man enough to win the game?
James gestures to the game behind him that has a bunch of bottles lined up.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Knock over the bottles and win a prize for your girl!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Hee hee! Can you win me a prize, $USR?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I'm on it.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I mean, what kind of criteria are they using? Whether or not I brushed my teeth? If I kiss you tonight?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: That doesn't really tell you anything.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: What's important is whether or not my date has a good time.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Hee hee. That's sweet, $USR!
Tina takes a note.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Hmph.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Hey, the ride's almost over.
The car comes out and halts at the exit.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Well, have fun! And remember... We'll be watching.
Tina spots another couple and runs off to evaluate them...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Hey! Marie! Get back here and bring that boy!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Thanks for being so understanding. Let's go check out the carnival games before Tina gets back!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Valentine's Day is hard enough on us guys without having to worry we're being graded.
Tina makes another note.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Subject is being uncooperative.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Agh!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: And possibly violent.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Stop fighting... The ride's already almost over.
The car comes out and halts at the exit.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Well, have fun! And remember... We'll be watching.
Tina spots another couple and runs off to evaluate them...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Hey! Marie! Get back here and bring that boy!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Come on, $USR. Let's go check out the carnival games, okay?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Fine.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Poor Dontae... I wish I could have been a better wingman earlier.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Heh. Cute.
You run to put the vase of flowers on her desk, but you trip! The vase crashes to the ground, shattering! You slip in the water and drop the stuffed bear out Beth's window!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Oh no! The bear's gone... And Beth's room is a mess. Water and glass shards everywhere weren't exactly my idea of a Valentine's Day surprise.
Just then, the door opens.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: $USR? What did you do to my room?!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Surprise?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I was trying to make today special by surprising you in your room... But as you can see, that backfired.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Aw, well. It's sweet that you tried... But next time, stick to something a little less ambitious.
A short walk later, you're at Beth's dorm room.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Just make sure you don't mess anything up.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Sure. Thanks for letting me in.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: And thanks for paying me $20. Happy Valentine's Day.
Tina writes something down on a clipboard she's carrying and leaves.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Okay, if I do this right, I can have it all set up for when Beth gets here... But I better hurry. I don't have much time!

options: Put the bear on the desk!
nodes.title: Make your choice!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Sorry about that. Now, where were we?
Suddenly, someone pops up from behind the car!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Took a call on the date. Not very attentive.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: AHH! Tina?! What are you doing back there?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Just the usual evaluation. Didn't you know there are two rows of seats in each car?
Tina pulls out her clipboard and looks you over.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Let's see here...
You and Beth play a few more of the carnival games... And after a half an hour, the carnival begins to shut down.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: All right, that's it! We're packing up.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Oh, already?

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Yeah. Tina said something about getting all the sisters together for the Annual Boyfriend Ranking. Good luck, $USR.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Great, I bet this is all Tina's idea.
Suddenly, you turn a corner, and run into Adam!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Oh. Hey, guys.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Adam? What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: I come to this museum every week. I like to see the changing exhibits and revisit my favorite pieces.

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: This might sound kind of lame, but there's something really soothing about being here.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: I... I feel the same way!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Really? What's your favorite piece here?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: 'The Hopeless Romantic'...

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: That's my favorite too!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I don't think we've, uh, seen that one... Raven, don't you think we should get going?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Just a minute, I want to talk to Adam! What's your favorite sculpture?

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: I also love 'The Guy Who Is About To Get Dumped'.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: That's such a tragic piece! What about the painting of 'This Girl Has More In Common With Someone Else'?

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Another classic!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I... Don't like where this is going...
Uh oh... Looks like $USR and Raven's relationship is in trouble! This is a terrible ending!
We know you can do better! Go give it another shot! Or try dating Beth or Lisa to see what Valentine's Day with them is like for $USR!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Poor Dontae... I wish I could have been a better wingman earlier.
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: A raven with a rose, huh? I love it.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: I thought you'd like it. Now, let's get to that museum you promised me.
A short drive later, you and Raven arrive at the museum's Valentine's Day exhibit.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: This is pretty nice, $USR. Let's go look at this portrait.
Just then, your phone rings!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Sorry, Raven. Can you hold on a sec?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Sure.
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Nelson
nodes.text: And there you go! All done.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Cool! Now I know the Chinese character for Raven.
Just then, Tina walks by and laughs.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: 'Raven'? Mahahaha. Um, sorry to tell you this, but that says 'Hummingbird'. Cute.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: `What?!` That's... That's so ridiculous!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]What?![/i][/color] That's... That's so ridiculous!

nodes.speaker: Nelson
nodes.text: Hey, I don't know Chinese. This is what Tina gave me. She's the one who set up the tattoo booth.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Great, this must be her idea of a joke.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Hey, forget Tina. It still looks cool. Now, what tattoo do you want me to get?
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Awesome! That looks really cool. It still says 'Valentine's Day', but in a way that's not all soft and fluffy.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Good choice, $USR. You really know me. Now let's see what you think of my choice for you!
